discovery_confirm.title: Set up {name}?
discovery_confirm.description: Pool Assistant found {name} on your account - add it to Home Assistant?

error.auth_failed: Could not log in - check your email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Logged in, but couldn't fetch or create your pool. Check the API key and project ID.
error.no_selection: Select at least one pool, or 'Create a new pool'.
error.already_configured_selection: Looks like you've already added all of the pools you picked. Choose a different one, or select 'Create a new pool' to add a brand new pool.

abort.already_configured: One or more pools in your selection are already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: This pool is already being set up elsewhere - check the Discovered section, or try again in a moment.

tooltip_section.name: Manual entry tooltips
tooltip_section.description: Shows an ID lookup tooltip on manually logged entries, but the Pool Assistant app will treat them as system records and won't let you edit them there anymore (Home Assistant still can).

polling_section.name: Polling
polling_section.description: How often Home Assistant checks Pool Assistant for updates.

discovery_section.name: New pool discovery
discovery_section.description: Turn off if you don't want Home Assistant automatically offering pools created directly in the app.

temperature_section.name: Water temperature
temperature_section.description: Link a temperature sensor to enable the automatic LSI sensor for this pool.

ideal_ranges.name: Ideal ranges
ideal_ranges.description: Override the default target range for any parameter. Each field shows its built-in default in its label - leave it blank to keep using that default.

pool_deleted.title: {name} no longer exists in your Pool Assistant account
pool_deleted.description: This pool appears to have been deleted from the app (or removed from your account) and can no longer be found. Home Assistant will keep trying and failing to update it until this is resolved.

confirm.title: Remove {name} from Home Assistant?
confirm.description: This pool no longer exists in your Pool Assistant account, so it can't be updated anymore. Removing it here only removes the Home Assistant integration entry - it won't affect anything in the app, since the pool is already gone there.
